root_idea.summary: The root centers on knowing or grasping a thing, especially apprehending its meaning.
root_idea.development: Its lexical range extends from grasping the meaning of speech to the mental capacity for quick understanding, and then to causative, sequential, reciprocal, and request constructions.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The sole Quran-attested group is presented under the normalized Form II perfect citation form.

senses.definition: To make someone understand a matter; to give or impart understanding of it.
senses.usage_conditions: Causative Form II. In 21:79, it denotes granting understanding of a matter; the evidence leaves open whether this occurred through enhanced understanding, intuitive impartation, or revelation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To understand or know something mentally; to apprehend its meaning.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used with عَنْهُ for understanding what another person said.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become a person of much understanding.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A stative or inchoative use related to being فَهِيم.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make someone understand or know a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative construction in Form IV.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To understand something progressively, one part after another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Especially applied to speech or language and its successive parts.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To endeavor to understand; also to affect or pretend to understand.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These effort and affectation senses are separately reported for the same Form V verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be made to understand or know.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported as a quasi-passive of فَهَّمَ or أَفْهَمَ, but explicitly judged to be an incorrect usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ask another to make one understand a thing; to seek clarification from someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form X construction with a person from whom understanding is sought.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Understanding: grasping the meaning conveyed by a word or expression, and the mental capacity or quickness to apprehend and discern.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun can denote either the act or result of grasping meaning or the intellectual condition enabling rapid apprehension.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An epithet for someone quick or abundant in understanding.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: فَهِيمٌ is an intensive form relative to فَهِمٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The meaning or sense in which a word or expression is understood.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical nominal use concerning the acceptation of an expression.
A proper-name use distinct from the semantic field of understanding.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Form I verb meaning is represented.
Stative Form I meaning is represented.
Form IV causative meaning is represented.
Effort, affectation, and pretence use is represented.
Reported quasi-passive use and its disapproval are represented.
Form X request-for-understanding construction is represented.
Noun meaning and intellectual-capacity branch are represented.

cautions: The Quranic occurrence in this packet is Form II; the related Form IV and Form X causative and request constructions are retained as broader Classical Arabic meanings rather than treated as additional Quranic forms.
The reported Form VII meaning is retained with its lexical qualification because the evidence explicitly describes it as incorrect.
